subject: The one-hour fix for leads that go cold
preheader: Three tools, three steps, and a prompt that writes your follow-ups for you.
headline: Stop losing leads you already paid for.
intro: Most leads don't say no. They just never hear back fast enough.
This week's stack catches every form fill, sends a friendly follow-up on its own, and drafts the personal replies for you. Connecting the tools takes about an hour.

tools.name: HubSpot
tools.why: Holds every lead and sends follow-up sequences.

tools.name: Zapier
tools.why: Pushes new leads from forms into HubSpot.

tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.why: Drafts personal follow-up emails in seconds.

steps: Create a free HubSpot account and import your lead list.
Connect your web form to HubSpot with a Zapier zap.
Write a 3 email follow up sequence with ChatGPT, then load it into HubSpot.

prompt.text: You're my sales assistant. Write a friendly 3-email follow up for a lead who asked about [service]. Email 1 goes out today, email 2 in 3 days, email 3 in a week. Keep each under 90 words, sound like a real person, and end each with one easy question.

tip.title: Quick win: reply within minutes
tip.body: Leads go cold fast. Even a one-line "Got your message, I'll call you at 3" keeps the conversation going.
